summary: ADVO demoed the Myriad / Fun Ride event site on a subdomain: an animated landing page with 16k, 10k and 5k routes, ticket tiers with inclusions (singlet, bib, medal, finisher shirt for 10k and 16k), a registration form with multi-participant entry and an ID-verified senior discount, and an organizer dashboard with volunteer code login, offline-capable QR scan or number search, check-in/claim/delete, and PDF ticket download; the reports template is not built yet and the mobile version is still being fixed. The demo content is from the previous event because the new event's venue (Luneta vs the grandstand) and assets are not final; the client will send sponsor logos, write-ups, infographics and posters, and ADVO suggested sponsor videos such as BYD cars. Payment via PayMongo or PayPal is still awaiting verification, so full testing waits on it; ADVO said the rest can be done within a week of receiving assets. On the contract, two payment options were sent in the group chat, 60,000 with a 50 peso convenience fee or 40,000 with a 60 peso convenience fee; the client will review and sign a soft copy first with wet signature to follow, and the down payment will be processed once the check is signed. The client asked for the event URL via Viber so their team (including Sam) can test independently.

fact.claim: The event site will open on a subdomain.
fact.quote: We'll be the subdomain to open the website.
fact.speaker: Speaker 2

fact.claim: The site lists three route distances: 16k, 10k and 5k, plus the schedule and location scenery.
fact.quote: Here you'll see the schedule and then you'll also see the routes: 16:00, 10:00, 5:00.
fact.speaker: Speaker 1

fact.claim: Ticket inclusions are a singlet, bib and medal, with a finisher shirt added for the 10k and 16k distances.
fact.quote: You'll see the inclusions that you'll get, which is the singlet, the 3k bib and medal. So on 10k or 16k you'll also get a finisher shirt.
fact.speaker: Speaker 1

fact.claim: The sponsors section is pending client review; per-brand write-ups can be inserted before the event.
fact.quote: They're pending your review or if you have any certain write ups you want to include per brand. Let us know and then we'll have it inserted in the website before the actual event.
fact.speaker: Speaker 3

fact.claim: Ticket prices spoken during the demo were '5K early bird', 900, 700 and 170 pesos, but the mapping of price to ticket tier is not clear from the transcript.
fact.quote: Here you can see you can choose your ticket. Five K early birds, nine hundred, seven hundred, one hundred and seventy pesos.
fact.speaker: Speaker 1

fact.claim: The registration form supports adding multiple participants and copying info between them.
fact.quote: I wanted us to input your name. Info, size more. You can add more participants. You can copy the info parameters from this list
fact.speaker: Speaker 1

fact.claim: Senior discount works by uploading an ID; the code checks the ID is authentic and matches the name to a registrant before discounting.
fact.quote: we can also add a senior discount. You have to upload an ID for verification. So the code will detect if the ID is authentic. Then it will match the name if it matches one of the registrants. The registrant will have a discounted price.
fact.speaker: Speaker 1

fact.claim: The organizer dashboard lets volunteers log in with a code and scan QR codes or search by number, and scanning works offline, syncing when signal returns.
fact.quote: So here, you can either scan your code or search the number. This is also compatible with offline, so you don't need Wi-Fi to scan because it will update the database once you get signal.
fact.speaker: Speaker 1

fact.claim: The registrant list supports check-in, claim (including claim by a representative) and delete.
fact.quote: These are the registrants. You can either check in or hit claim. Pag kunwari claim by someone else or representative. Hit pa delete natin.
fact.speaker: Speaker 1

fact.claim: Registrants can download a PDF of their registration with their QR code.
fact.quote: So that they can download the PDF of their registration and secure code.
fact.speaker: Speaker 1

fact.claim: The reports and statistics template in the organizer dashboard is not built yet.
fact.quote: Here's the reports and other statistics. Template is not available yet, so it's just this.
fact.speaker: Speaker 1

fact.claim: The event has a shareable link (transcribed as 'events dot onerideph dot m') and the mobile version is still being fixed.
fact.quote: Of this event, it's called period. Events dot onerideph dot m. What is this? And this is also compatible to mobile. We're still fixing the mobile version.
fact.speaker: Speaker 1

fact.claim: The dev team present was introduced as Johan, David and Anthony; Sam (client side) checks sponsorship design.
fact.quote: So the Dev team are here. Johan, David, Anthony.
fact.speaker: Speaker 5

fact.claim: ADVO needs only the standard assets from the client: infographics and the poster; ADVO designs the rest.
fact.quote: We don't have any additional requirements. Just the standard things that we need, which is the infographics, the poster itself. That's all that's needed from us. Then we'll just design it.
fact.speaker: Speaker 1

fact.claim: The venue is undecided between Luneta and a grandstand (transcribed as 'Cebuano Grandstand').
fact.quote: Luneta na tayo or in Cebuano Grandstand?
fact.speaker: Speaker 5

fact.claim: The current demo is populated with the previous event's information because the new event's details are not yet available.
fact.quote: This one is for the previous event. Let's say we didn't have information on the new event yet.
fact.speaker: Speaker 1

fact.claim: The client asked to improve the login page UI and add an introductory landing page with a 'continue to events' button before the events list.
fact.quote: Maybe improve our login page. ... the first thing they'll see is the website, and then there's a button continue to events. So it won't be sudden what they'll see.
fact.speaker: Speaker 4

fact.claim: Users can sign up for an event without being logged in, receive an email, and pay through PayMongo or PayPal.
fact.quote: They can still sign up even if they're not signed in. But you'll know, you'll receive the email. Then just follow the PayMongo or PayPal for working.
fact.speaker: Speaker 4

fact.claim: About three days of design effort was cited for the requested design work.
fact.quote: For three days of designing. We'll generate that, we'll do that. Effort in the designing.
fact.speaker: Speaker 1

fact.claim: Payment integration is not finished; an update on payment is expected so the client can see it working.
fact.quote: At least we can show the update on our payment so that there's no more payment. It's only in line with our payment. It's not finished yet with the payment.
fact.speaker: Speaker 4

fact.claim: ADVO suggested sponsor visuals such as a BYD car video instead of logos only, to make sponsor placement interactive.
fact.quote: Maganda pong i-add natin yung visuals ng mga sponsors. Kunyari yung kapag BYD, may videong mga kotse nila parang ganon para mas interactive siya. Instead na logo lang yung nakadisenyo makikita mo talaga yung business nila.
fact.speaker: Speaker 1

fact.claim: Venue background images were taken from Google; the client may supply Intramuros or Manila City Hall pictures and multiple pictures are fine.
fact.quote: I just took the pictures from Google. That's how I made it.
fact.speaker: Speaker 1

fact.claim: ADVO needs the assets before setting a proper execution timeline; once assets arrive, everything can be done in about a week.
fact.quote: We need the assets po muna in order to set execution proper na timeline, po natin pero, if ever makakahanap niyo assets, everything can be done in a week
fact.speaker: Speaker 3

fact.claim: Full testing is blocked on payment verification; visuals and functionality other than payment are ready.
fact.quote: I think we can go on with the full testing. We're still waiting for the payment. We need to be verified ... Pero visuals and functionality wise aside from payment kaya na ba i-merchandise?
fact.speaker: Speaker 3

fact.claim: Two contract payment options were sent in the group chat: 60,000 with a 50 peso convenience fee, or 40,000 with a 60 peso convenience fee.
fact.quote: there were two payment options. I believe one of them was 60,000 with a 50 pesos convenience fee while the other one was 40,000 with a 60 pesos convenience fee. They're both in GC.
fact.speaker: Speaker 7

fact.claim: ADVO is waiting on the client's availability for contract signing and on their choice between the two payment options.
fact.quote: Also, I have other concerns regarding the contract signing. Whenever you are available for signing and the one in GC regarding the contract, there were two payment options.
fact.speaker: Speaker 7

fact.claim: The contract will be a soft copy first, reviewed and sent by the client, with wet signature to follow.
fact.quote: Initial contract, soft copy muna. And then to follow natin yung wet signature I'll sign this.
fact.speaker: Speaker 5

fact.claim: The client asked for the event URL so their team, including Sam, can test on their own.
fact.quote: Yun URL na lang no? Pahingi niyo akong link ng URL, so we can test same with Sam as well. Para natin makita rin namin on our own.
fact.speaker: Speaker 5

fact.claim: The link and details will be submitted through Viber.
fact.quote: So isusubmit nila po sa Viber yung ano paano ko po ba yung sa D?
fact.speaker: Speaker 1

fact.claim: The down payment will be processed once the check is signed.
fact.quote: So down Payment. So down payment. But I have received those payments. Payment. We will process then just tell me once signed your check. pa lang kasi yun.
fact.speaker: Speaker 5

decision.text: Contract proceeds as a soft copy first, with wet signature to follow after the client reviews it.
The client will supply sponsor assets (logos, write-ups, infographics, poster); ADVO designs and inserts them, and updates when new assets arrive.
Execution timeline is set only after assets are delivered; ADVO targets about a week from asset receipt.
Full testing waits on payment (PayMongo/PayPal) verification; non-payment visuals and functionality are treated as ready.
An introductory landing page with a 'continue to events' button will be added before the events list, and the login page UI improved.
Venue (Luneta vs grandstand) is NOT decided; the site keeps previous-event content until new details arrive.

action.description: Send the event URL and details to the client via Viber for independent testing (including Sam)
Send the initial contract soft copy; client reviews and signs, wet signature to follow
Choose between the two contract payment options (60,000 + 50 fee or 40,000 + 60 fee) and confirm signing availability
Process the down payment once the check is signed
Complete PayMongo/PayPal payment verification and show a working payment update
Provide sponsor assets: logos, per-brand write-ups, infographics, poster, and optionally sponsor videos (e.g. BYD)
Finalize the venue (Luneta vs grandstand) and the new event details so the site can be updated
Improve the login page UI and add an intro landing page with a 'continue to events' button
Build the reports and statistics template in the organizer dashboard
Finish the mobile version of the event site
Send the event details to ADVO today

openQuestion.text: What is the exact ticket price per distance and tier (early bird vs regular)? The demo mentioned 900, 700 and 170 pesos without a clear mapping.
Which contract payment option will the client take: 60,000 + 50 convenience fee or 40,000 + 60 convenience fee?
Will the venue be Luneta or the grandstand?
When will PayMongo/PayPal verification complete so payment can go live and full testing can start?
What sponsor asset formats (video, image sizes, copy) will the client provide, e.g. for BYD?
